items.title: Federico Stefanovich revamps studio in 1920s Mexico City building to showcase his lighting
items.summary: Designer Federico Stefanovich converted his Mexico City studio in a 1920s building to display his own metal lighting fixtures, with interiors by Nama Studio.

items.title: Pharos powers heritage facade lighting at Parliament of Victoria
items.summary: Pharos control system replaces an ageing sodium vapour floodlighting scheme on Melbourne's Parliament of Victoria, enabling more refined, adjustable illumination of the heritage facade.
